nodes.label: Spotify Authorization Code with PKCE
nodes.rationale: Static web app needs no client secret; client ID in localStorage, refresh token in sessionStorage. Redirect must use 127.0.0.1 since Spotify disallows localhost and file:// URLs.

nodes.label: Song-to-opening matching with fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Normalized title + artist match; falls back to track/album info to find anime's first opening, then to cover art.

nodes.label: Local video cache (video-cache/, 3 GB LRU)
nodes.rationale: AnimeThemes video host rate-limits rapid requests, so server.js downloads each video once and streams while downloading; least recently watched evicted first.
